newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end lower as bond losses spill over.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end lower as bond losses spill over.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended lower on Thursday after bond market losses spilled over and dealers closed positions ahead of the long weekend.
The general index fell 0.67 points, 0.16 percent, to 408.19 and the Ibex shed 10.49 points, 0.22 percent, to 4,714.04.
Telefonica seemd immune to selling after reports that its upcoming placement will be 60 percent retail. The stock rose 15 pesetas to 2,865.
Endesa ended off 80 pesetas at 8,590 after announcing a 100 pesetas gross per share interim dividend.
Friday's public holiday added to a prudent climate after a recent run, with dealers additionally wary ahead of tomorrow's key U.S. employment report.
"The market tried to pick up yesterday's losses and for a moment we could have consolidated the advance, but the long weekend injected some caution," said one trader.
Turnover was markedly lower, totalling around 43.7 billion pesetas.
